turnaround_reason: Coty sits near multi-year lows (~$2.86, 52-week range $1.82-$4.56) after pulling its fiscal 2026 guidance, the departure of CEO Sue Nabi, and underperformance in Consumer Beauty. An interim CEO launched a 'Coty. Curated' plan, is returning the Gucci Beauty license to Kering for ~$400M, and is reviewing the mass color cosmetics business.
bullish_points: 'Coty. Curated' restructuring plus ~$400M Gucci license return gives cash and a cost-savings lever ('belts and suspenders' approach)
Forward P/E ~11 on a portfolio that still has prestige fragrance strength, near washed-out sentiment
Recovering screen mode with price ~8% above its 200d MA; large fragrance franchise remains a real asset
bearish_points: Guidance was pulled and like-for-like revenue is still declining (-3% in Q2 FY26); Q1 FY27 guided to a further low-to-mid-single-digit LFL decline
Heavy leverage with thin liquidity: ~$3.30B debt vs only $176M cash (debt/equity ~98) — little room if the beauty cycle stays soft
Leadership vacuum (interim CEO) plus lawsuits cloud the turnaround; no insider buying at all in the last 6 months
Losing the Gucci license removes a revenue stream that restructuring must scramble to offset
catalyst: Interim-to-permanent CEO clarity and execution on 'Coty. Curated' cost savings + a stabilization in Consumer Beauty LFL trends
catalyst_timing: Fiscal 2027 (multi-quarter); no single hard near-term event
suggested_trade: Watchlist only / pass. Wait for a permanent CEO and one quarter of LFL stabilization before touching it; a highly-levered falling knife with no insider conviction.
key_risk: Continued LFL declines against ~$3.3B of debt force further guidance cuts or a balance-sheet event before the turnaround takes hold
would_skip_if: Always for now — no permanent CEO, guidance withdrawn, LFL still negative, zero insider buying, heavy leverage
